title: Tenured Summit Members and the Extension Term of Crestline Credits
content:
**Summit benefit term.** The extension term of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is built on its tenured-member term. The tenured-member term follows the holder's Summit tier and the enrolment date of the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program:

- **8 calendar months** for a Summit Platinum, Summit Diamond or Summit Chairman member, and for a Summit Gold member whose Summit membership was enrolled at least 60 whole calendar months before the request date;
- **7 calendar months** for any other Summit Gold member, and for a Summit Silver member enrolled at least 60 whole calendar months before the request date;
- **the instrument's extension months** for every other holder.

A whole calendar month counts only once the same day of the month is reached, and exactly 60 whole months counts as reached.

## Tier and enrolment in combination

| Summit tier | Enrolled at least 60 whole calendar months before the request date | Tenured-member term |
|---|---|---|
| Summit Chairman, Summit Diamond or Summit Platinum | yes or no | 8 months |
| Summit Gold | yes | 8 months |
| Summit Gold | no | 7 months |
| Summit Silver | yes | 7 months |
| Summit Silver | no | instrument's extension months |
| Summit Member, or no Summit membership | not applicable | instrument's extension months |

## Enrolment edge (hypothetical enrolment on 10 July 2021)

- A request dated 10 July 2026 falls 60 whole calendar months after enrolment. A Summit Gold holder then has 8 months, and a Summit Silver holder has 7 months.
- A request dated 9 July 2026 falls 59 whole calendar months after enrolment. A Summit Gold holder then has 7 months, and a Summit Silver holder has the instrument's extension months.
